score_semantics: classifier score; not a calibrated probability
annotation: Alu intervals from the GRCh38 RepeatMasker annotation
limitations: Catalogue RNA-editing positives are weak labels unless accompanied by an explicit reference whole-genome genotype.
Calibration constrains empirical canonical DNA-labelled candidates, not all genomic errors.
The development benchmark informed prior error analysis; performance on it is not an independent held-out evaluation.
